free_vs_paid.free_area: Awareness and information — everything a student or parent needs to understand the options: stream selection guidance, the entrance exam calendar, career guides, scholarship and college information, plus a free aptitude test with a short WhatsApp report.
free_vs_paid.paid_area: Personalised guidance — interpretation of aptitude results and one-to-one counselling for the student and family, ending in a written action plan, with support through the year. Current price: Rs 999 per year (subscription).
free_vs_paid.boundary_rule: The section shows both areas separately. Information stays free; the paid service begins only at personalised interpretation and the counselling session. Nothing is placed behind a paywall without a clear label.

content_inventory: Career path trees: after Class 10 (Science PCB, Science PCM, Commerce, Arts, ITI, Polytechnic) and after Class 12, with eligibility, entrance exams, duration, fees (government vs private), next options, jobs and entry salaries

Scholarships and education finance: national and state schemes, loan basics and fee waivers
Job market and salary updates for major careers
Stream selection guide for Class 10 students
Counselling toolkit: assessment instruments (NCERT TAMANNA, O*NET RIASEC interest profiler, work importance, personality basics), interpretation guidance, session frameworks and report templates

Career Explorer: interactive bilingual tool (v6 build in progress)

business_plan.model: Low-price, high-volume counselling. Free school workshops introduce the service; students take a free aptitude test; a short WhatsApp report follows; families who want personalised help book a paid one-to-one session (Rs 999). Growth comes through the teacher network, where schools can arrange workshops for a batch of students.
business_plan.audience: Students in Classes 8-12 and their parents, mainly in the Hindi belt, reached through teacher and school networks.

items.title: Career Explorer (Interactive Tool)
items.description: An interactive, bilingual tool to explore career paths step by step — from stream choice to courses, exams, colleges and jobs. Built entirely from our own research and free to use. Now live on the website.

items.title: Class 10 Stream Selection Guide
items.description: A practical guide for Class 10 students and parents on choosing a stream: Science (PCB or PCM), Commerce, Arts, ITI and Polytechnic diplomas. It explains who each option suits, where it leads, typical costs, and a three-step method — interest, aptitude, family reality — for a sound decision. Simple language, based on our own research.

items.title: Entrance Exam Calendar 2026-27
items.description: One page for the 20 exams that matter most: NEET, JEE Main and Advanced, CUET, CLAT, CTET, SSC, RRB, CAT and more. Each entry shows the application window, exam dates and the official website, labelled CONFIRMED, EXPECTED or NOT ANNOUNCED so no expected date is mistaken for an official one. Updated every Monday.

items.title: Free Career Aptitude Test
items.description: Take a free aptitude test built on NCERT's TAMANNA test for Classes 9-10, together with interest and work-importance tools used worldwide. Send your result on WhatsApp and receive a short report showing your strengths and the streams or careers that fit. No fee and no obligation — this is the first step of our guidance process.

items.title: Career Counselling Service (Rs 999 per year)
items.description: A year-long subscription to our career counselling service: personalised interpretation of aptitude and interest results, matching with real courses and careers, honest comparison of costs and competition, and a written action plan — with support through the year. Available online or in person. This is a paid service, clearly separate from the free information on this site.

items.title: Career Guides by Stream
items.description: Detailed guides for Science (PCB and PCM), Commerce and Arts: courses after Class 12, entrance exams, government and private fees, and realistic job and salary expectations. Each guide is checked against official sources and updated through the year.

items.title: Scholarships & Education Finance
items.description: National and state scholarship schemes with eligibility, application windows and documents required, plus education loan basics and fee waivers. Helps families plan the cost of a course before choosing it.

items.title: Top Colleges & Institutes (NIRF 2025)
items.description: Profiles of 179 top institutes from the NIRF 2025 rankings — universities, colleges, engineering, medical, law, management, pharmacy and more — with programmes offered, admission routes and official fee information.

items.title: Parents' Corner
items.description: Short, honest articles for parents: how to discuss careers without pressure, what a family budget can realistically support, and the questions worth asking before a course is chosen.

items.title: Career Counselling Workshops
items.description: Free career-awareness and guidance sessions for schools, teachers and students — on campus or online, in Hinglish and Hindi. Sessions cover career options, stream selection and common mistakes, with an open Q&A.

items.title: Career Ladders: Indirect Routes to Top Positions
items.description: Not every senior position is reached directly. This section maps step-by-step routes — for example, reaching a KVS commissioner post through teaching and promotion, or the IAS through a state service — so ambition is not blocked by a single pathway.

items.title: Business Ideas After Courses
items.description: Realistic self-employment options that follow naturally from a course — for example, a medical store after a pharmacy degree or a workshop after an ITI trade — with a one-line note on what each needs to get started.

items.title: Coaching Costs & Competition Reality
items.description: Honest numbers for major careers: whether coaching is necessary, typical coaching costs, how many candidates compete for how many seats, and how vacancies are trending. The reality check most career websites leave out.
